# citrix_resource_access_policy (Data Source)

Read data of an existing site-wide resource access policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get Resource Access Policy detail by name
data "citrix_resource_access_policy" "example_policy_by_name" {
    name = "Example Resource Access Policy"
}

# Get Resource Access Policy detail by id
data "citrix_resource_access_policy" "example_policy_by_id" {
    id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource access policy. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource access policy. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the resource access policy.
- `enable_criteria_for_exclude_connections` (Boolean) Whether the criteria for exclude connections are enabled.
- `enable_criteria_for_include_connections` (Boolean) Whether the criteria for include connections are enabled.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the resource access policy is enabled.
- `exclude_criteria_filters` (Attributes List) The SmartAccess filters which deny access to a connection that matches any of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclude_criteria_filters))
- `include_connections_criteria_type` (String) Whether a connection must match all (`MatchAll`) or any (`MatchAny`) of the `include_criteria_filters` to be granted access.
- `include_criteria_filters` (Attributes List) The SmartAccess filters a connection must match to be granted access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--include_criteria_filters))
- `metadata` (Attributes List) Metadata of the resource access policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `resource_type` (String) Type of resource the policy applies to.
- `tag_id` (String) GUID identifier of the tag whose resources the policy applies to.
- `tag_name` (String) Name of the tag whose resources the policy applies to.

<a id="nestedatt--exclude_criteria_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exclude_criteria_filters`

Read-Only:

- `filter_name` (String) The name of the filter.
- `filter_value` (String) The value of the filter.
